about_the_game:
================================
Game Introduction
================================

Juggernaut Lyra disappeared to investigate the forest's mutation;
You also went into the forest in search of Lyra;
You will experience a small story in the face of chapter after chapter;

In each chapter, the face of defeating the vast number of enemies!

================================
Game Features
================================

  • Game weapon attack mode for automatic attack;
  • The rhythm is fast, each game is within 30 minutes;
  • There are a total of 30 chapter levels;
  • Support LAN online and Steam online games;
  • Hundreds of props and weapons are available for exploration and purchase;
  • Kill the enemy to get money, buy props and weapons to strengthen themselves;
  • The Beast Spirit Usage System can obtain super powerful Beast Spirit attributes with a certain probability;

================================
Game mode
================================

  • Choose a level, and then enter the battle;
  • Enemies will always appear, defeat all the enemies coming towards you;
  • Defeat the final BOSS to pass;

================================
Game operation
================================

  • Move the up, down, left and right direction keys;
  • Action keys: Z key, X key, C key, V key;
